methodology.scope: All recoverable genuinely pregame modeled games, including passes; no retrospective wagers.
methodology.predictionSelection: Latest published pre-kickoff board/snapshot within 7 days; use same-time priced record where available. All-three comparison uses one common saved board and market per game.
methodology.timestampRule: Both original Git commit publication and embedded observation time must precede scheduled kickoff.
methodology.precision: Original numeric home margins when saved; otherwise original displayed half-point fair lines.
methodology.marketBenchmark: Market spread saved with the prediction; this is NOT a verified closing-line benchmark.
methodology.hypotheticalRoi: One unit risked per directional signal at assumed -110; excludes zero-edge passes. Not actual betting returns.
methodology.bias: Prediction minus actual home margin; positive means overrating home teams.
methodology.legacy: Single-model pre-three-model forecasts are kept separate. No missing Ensemble fair is inferred.
methodology.calibration: Research only; train W4-5, validate W6-7; partial W8 excluded; no production weights changed.

totals.note: Legacy/governed total forecasts only; not three separate total models.

dataIntegrityFindings.detail: Historical snapshot writer read game.ensembleFair instead of game.multiModel.ensemble.fair. Missing Ensemble forecasts were recovered only from contemporaneous board history.

Historical snapshot writer labelled game.modelSpread as marketCalibratedFair although modelSpread could contain the selected Ensemble. Such snapshot values are now classified as governed/ambiguous and excluded from named Market-Calibrated comparisons.
